title: Bonanza Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Biltwell Bonanza Anthracite is crafted for classic motorcycle enthusiasts seeking unrestricted peripheral sightlines. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1146g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~96 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Ultra-minimalist open face helmet with hand-painted graphics options.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for open-face fit; may feel tight on larger head sizes due to internal EPS liner density.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Biltwell Bonanza Anthracite: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Biltwell's Open Face lineup, the Bonanza Anthracite brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Biltwell Bonanza Anthracite represents Biltwell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~96 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Biltwell Bonanza Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
